body:
Approved implementation plan (auto-approved gate, epic #99 autonomous run)

Design: modals render through a portal on document.body so every confirm centers on the viewport with a full-page backdrop; typed confirm uses a random 4-character code (case-insensitive). Full lockstep rename "Sites" -> "Site Policy": page /ui/site-policy/, API /api/ui/site-policy/global-rules[/:domain], /api/ui/site-policy/events, /api/ui/site-policy/global-tier/toggle (per-agent routes unchanged), WebSocket sites_changed -> site_policy_changed, api.js getGlobalRules/createGlobalRule/deleteGlobalRule/getSitePolicyEvents, CSS wp-sites-* -> wp-site-policy-* and wp-global-list-* -> wp-rules-modal-*. Layout: a compact strip of two small cards (Global block list and Per-agent rules, each with a Manage button) above the access log, which becomes the main element. One reusable RulesModal (global or agent scope) whose list, add and delete-confirm views replace each other in a fixed-height shell. Access log columns: Domain, Agent (links to the agent), Status with a color indicator, Last seen, Action; "Default" relabeled "No rule (allowed by default)". Agents page gains an ?agent= filter.

Sub-tasks:
- [U1] Modal portal + mobile touch targets + random-code typed confirm + stories (Sonnet)
- [U2] Backend/API and WebSocket lockstep rename + tests (Sonnet)
- [U3] Web UI folder rename, compact layout, RulesModal, access log columns, api.js and CSS renames (Sonnet) — after U1, U2
- [U4] Agents page ?agent= filter (Haiku) — with U3
- [U5] Docs, CHANGELOG, PR #118 body (Haiku/Sonnet) — after U3
- [U6] Verification (Sonnet) — last
